name: Moto Guzzi V7 Sport / 750S
engine: 748 cc air-cooled 90-degree V-twin, two carbs, shaft drive
intro: Guzzi's first sport twin, on the Tonti frame. Very collectible now, with shaft drive and a separate gearbox.

K: Guzzi big twins use a car-type dry clutch and a separate gearbox and final drive. Change all three oils, not just the engine oil.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
